derived_from: SKILL.md § 1. Derive the acceptance checklist from the spec
prompt: A feature branch is green on unit tests. Validate it before merge.
assertions: the acceptance checklist is derived from the spec rather than invented from the diff
both happy paths and the edge and error criteria are represented

prompt: The feature has both an HTTP API and a browser UI.
assertions: API surface work routes to the API validator and UI surface work to the UI validator
a surface present in the feature is not skipped because the other one passed

derived_from: TESTS.md § v1.2.0 — consume docs/agents/verify.md when present
prompt: Unit tests are green. docs/agents/verify.md exists with Launch/Doctor/Drive for create-note.
assertions: Launch and Doctor come from docs/agents/verify.md before checklist items
a persist/reload check named in that file is not skipped
when verify.md is missing the skill names /cmk:repo-config rather than invoking it
